bagPolicy.summary: A small purse or bag under 12" x 6" x 12" is allowed. All bags are searched, and backpacks, briefcases and luggage are not permitted.
allowed: Small purse or bag under 12" x 6" x 12"
prohibited: Computer or laptop bags and cases
bagPolicy.note: Coat check is in the main lobby, first come first served. Bags refused at entry cannot be left at coat check. Some exceptions may be made for special events.

parking.note: Parking information is not directly accessible from the provided URL. Please enable JavaScript to view detailed parking options and pricing on the official website.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in The Armory's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at The Armory varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by The Armory, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in The Armory's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Armory's box office is located on 6th street corner of 5th Ave South. Yes, we have a lost and found located in the box office.
